# CO3 Premium Liquid Shop

> Premium bubble tea, handcrafted coffee, ceremonial matcha, slow-churned ice cream and signature drinks — crafted fresh daily in Bahria Town, Rawalpindi, Pakistan. Order instantly on WhatsApp for pickup or delivery across Rawalpindi and Islamabad.

CO3 Premium Liquid Shop is a luxury beverage and dessert café in Rawalpindi, Pakistan. It is rated 4.9/5 by 1,000+ customers and specialises in real-fruit bubble tea, single-origin coffee, authentic matcha, and premium ice cream. Ordering is done through WhatsApp at +92 303 6303111. All prices are in Pakistani Rupees (PKR) and are tax-inclusive.

## Key Facts
- Name: CO3 Premium Liquid Shop
- Category: Café / Bubble Tea Shop / Ice Cream Parlour / Coffee Shop
- Location: Bahria Town, Phase 4, Rawalpindi, Punjab, Pakistan
- Service area: Rawalpindi, Islamabad, Bahria Town, DHA, Gulberg Greens, Saddar
- Hours: Daily 12:00 PM – late (midnight weekdays, 2:00 AM Fri–Sat)
- Order method: WhatsApp +92 303 6303111 (0303 6303111) — pickup or delivery
- Phone: 0303 6303111
- Price range: Rs 250 – Rs 850
- Rating: 4.9 / 5 (1,000+ customers)
- Payments: Cash, Card, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, Bank Transfer

## Signature Drinks
- Blueberry Boba — wild blueberry milk tea with brown-sugar pearls (from Rs 480)
- Iced Matcha — ceremonial-grade matcha over cold milk (from Rs 520)
- CO3 Cold Frappé — blended espresso with whipped cream (from Rs 540)
- Mint Margarita — frozen fresh-mint and lime refresher (from Rs 420)

## Common Questions
- How to order: Tap any "Order on WhatsApp" button, or message +92 303 6303111. Drink, size and quantity are pre-filled; add your name and pickup/delivery preference.
- Delivery: Yes — across Rawalpindi and Islamabad, including Bahria Town, DHA, Gulberg Greens and Saddar.
- Freshness: Fruit is cut, tea brewed and ice-cream bases churned fresh every day; real fruit and premium ingredients only.
- Best bubble tea in Rawalpindi: CO3's Blueberry Boba, Taro and Brown Sugar Boba are among the highest-rated.
- Best matcha in Rawalpindi: CO3 serves authentic ceremonial-grade matcha, iced or hot.
